mapper.select: SELECT rid, p_reg_id, code, name, level, ST_AsEWKT(geom) AS geom, status, c_date, u_date FROM tb_reg WHERE rid = #{rid} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_reg WHERE p_reg_id = #{rid}
SELECT ST_GeometryType(g) IN ('ST_Polygon', 'ST_MultiPolygon') AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(g) AND ST_IsValid(g) FROM (SELECT ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{geom, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS g) AS geometry_input
mapper.sql: c.rid, c.p_reg_id, c.code, c.name, c.level, ST_AsEWKT(c.geom) AS geom, c.status, c.c_date, c.u_date, p.code AS p_code, p.name AS p_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_reg c LEFT JOIN tb_reg p ON p.rid = c.p_reg_id WHERE c.rid = #{rid}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tb_reg ( p_reg_id, code, name, level, geom, status, c_date, u_date ) VALUES ( #{parentRegId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{code}, #{name}, #{level}, ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{geom, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{status}, COALESCE(#{cDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{uDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
SELECT currval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tb_reg', 'rid'))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_reg SET p_reg_id = #{parentRegId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, code = #{code}, name = #{name}, level = #{level}, geom = ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{geom, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), status = #{status}, u_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rid = #{rid}
